name: io.github.lahma/claude-roslyn-lsp
description: C# refactoring over MCP, backed by Microsoft's Roslyn language server: semantic rename, code actions, fix-all, formatting, symbol lookup and design-time diagnostics.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_SOLUTION
environmentVariables.description: Path to the .slnx, .sln or .csproj to load. Optional: the adapter discovers one from the working directory. Set it in a monorepo, where discovery picks a solution that is often not the one being worked in.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_ROSLYN_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the pinned roslyn-language-server version the adapter downloads from nuget.org. Optional; the pin is the only version this release is tested against.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_ROSLYN_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding an already-installed Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.LanguageServer.dll, used instead of downloading one. Optional; set it to run air-gapped or against a locally built server.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_ROSLYN_LSP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical or None (default Information). Logs go to stderr only - stdout is the JSON-RPC channel.
